13. (Currently amended) A system for electronically providing a[[n]] electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the system comprising:  
a merchant server for receiving certificate selection information related to the selection of an electronic value certificate and associated recipient data from a certificate selection device and generating electronic value certificate data; and  
an over the air (OTA) provisioning server for receiving the electronic value certificate selection data from the merchant server, establishing a communications link with a mobile device associated with recipient data, and provisioning the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications, __wherein the electronic value certificate data includes personalization data that is used to generate a softcard electronic coupon in the mobile device, and wherein the personalization data is provisioned to at least one of a secure element and mobile base band memory in the mobile device__.

23. (Previously presented) The system of claim 13 wherein the certificate selection device includes at least one of a personal computer, a kiosk station, and a smart poster.

24. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13 wherein the mobile device comprises a first __near field communication (NFC)__ enabled device, and is configured to transfer the electronic value certificate to a second __near field communication (NFC)__ enabled mobile device.

25. (Currently amended) A __non-transitory__ computer readable medium having stored thereon comprising computer executable instructions that when executed by a processor of a computer performs steps comprising:  
utilizing a certificate selection device to generate electronic certificate selection information;  
providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server;  
receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information __and the associated recipient data, wherein the electronic value certificate data includes personalization data__;  
establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and  
provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications, __including provisioning the personalization data to at least one of a secure element and mobile base band memory in the mobile device__.
